title: Service-Recovery Reduction on Bank Deposit Recall Fees after Late Delivery
content:
Where a Bank Deposit transfer reached the recipient late and the transfer's ledger carries a late-delivery refund, a service-recovery reduction is taken off the recall fee for a recall on that transfer.

## Clause

When the transfer's ledger carries a late-delivery refund and the deposit date came at least 3 calendar days after the date of availability, the full service-recovery reduction of 2.75 US dollars applies; when the ledger carries a late-delivery refund and the deposit date came at least 1 but fewer than 3 calendar days after the date of availability, the partial service-recovery reduction of 1.25 US dollars applies; otherwise no service-recovery reduction applies.

The reduction is subtracted, in dollars, from the recall fee that would otherwise be charged: it is not scaled by any percentage, the recall fee never goes below zero, and rounding to the cent happens once, on the final fee.

## Records read

- **Late-delivery refund on the ledger.** A fee refund on the transfer's ledger with the reason late delivery.
- **Gap.** The calendar days from the transfer's date of availability to its deposit date.

## Condition table

| Late-delivery refund on the ledger? | Calendar days from date of availability to deposit | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 3 or more | 2.75 |
| yes | 1 or 2 | 1.25 |
| yes | 0 or fewer | none |
| no | any | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- Date of availability 4 May, deposited 9 May (5 days), late-delivery refund on the ledger: 2.75.
- Date of availability 4 May, deposited 6 May (2 days), late-delivery refund on the ledger: 1.25.
- Date of availability 4 May, deposited 7 May (3 days), no late-delivery refund on the ledger: none.
